scope: User-proposed China and global data, publication, policy, financial, legal and geospatial sources
principles: Prefer official APIs and repositories over third-party wrappers
Do not install analysis libraries as if they were data sources
Do not duplicate an existing managed provider or connector
Reject packages whose described capability cannot be verified
Keep every runtime operation read-only, bounded and host-allowlisted
